image.description: A cloud image (qcow2 or raw) written onto the disk on the VM's first start, while the disk is still blank. Later changes do not touch the disk. Left unset, the disk is used as it is

checksum.description: The file's SHA-256 or SHA-512 in hex

checksumUrl.description: A SHA256SUMS or SHA512SUMS file that lists the image by its file name, used when checksum is unset

cloudInit.title: Cloud-init
cloudInit.description: Handed to the image's cloud-init on the first boot

sshKeys.title: SSH keys
sshKeys.description: Public keys that may log in. In the web form, gh:<user> imports a GitHub user's keys

user.description: A login user to create, with sudo rights and the SSH keys. Left unset, the keys go to the image's own user

setup.title: First-boot setup
setup.description: Packages to install, then shell commands to run as root, on the first boot only. Their output is in the VM's console log. The VM counts as RUNNING before they finish

x-expanse-presets.label: Pando 0.12.0 under Docker (Debian 13 or Ubuntu 24.04, 40 GiB disk or more)

runcmd: apt-get install -y docker-compose-v2 || apt-get install -y docker-compose
until curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/; do sleep 2; done; sync
echo "pando: console at http://$(hostname -I | cut -d' ' -f1):8080; sign-in token: docker exec pando-pando-1 pando admin setup-token"

packages.description: Package names for the image's package manager (apt on Debian and Ubuntu)

runcmd.title: Commands
runcmd.description: One shell command per line, run in order after the packages are installed. A failing command does not stop the rest; end it with || exit 1 to stop there

mac.description: Explicit guest NIC MAC override. Left unset, a stable, locally-administered MAC is derived once from the block instance's own name (PHASE-06-TASKS.md D2/D4 pattern) — identical across every failover, never regenerated or tied to a node or its macvtap parent interface

bootKernel.description: Nix store path to a kernel for direct-kernel-boot, bypassing whatever bootloader (if any) the raw volume's own disk holds. PHASE-06-TASKS.md D4 leaves getting a first bootable guest OS onto an empty volume out of this phase's own scope (document, don't build); this is the escape hatch that lets a guest boot at all before that exists — bootInitrd/bootCmdline go with it. Left unset (the production default), the VMM boots from the attached disk the ordinary BIOS way, exactly like a physical machine

bootInitrd.description: Nix store path to the initramfs paired with bootKernel. Ignored unless bootKernel is set

bootCmdline.description: Kernel command line, only used with bootKernel

cpuModel.description: CPU model the guest sees. host passes the node's CPU through, including vmx/svm, so the guest can run KVM itself (nested virtualization); the guest can then only restart on nodes with the same CPU features. Left unset, qemu's default model, with no virtualization extensions

guestReady.description: When the VM counts as RUNNING. systemd (the default): once the guest's systemd reports over vsock that it booted to multi-user.target. none: as soon as qemu-kvm starts, for guests without systemd 254 or newer
